reviewItem.question: Does "Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the `regardingObject`. If you are using `regardingObject` as a `field-selector` for listing events…" mean a change to protocol-behavior:strimzi|name=pod-restart-event-regardingobject (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the regardingObject; they now reference the Kafka resource instead.
